shade.title: Choose a blind or shade
shade.description: All settings use percent OPEN: 0 closed, 100 open. Add separate controllers for lift and tilt if your blind supports both.

data.name: Name
data.invert_position: This device reports 0% as fully open

sun.title: Sun tracking
sun.description: Face outward through the window to measure its direction. For lift, measure the covered height and choose how far sunlight may reach indoors. For tilt, 100% open must mean horizontal slats and 0% closed must mean vertical slats; use inversion if needed.

data.azimuth: Direction the window faces (0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west)
data.sun_depth: How far sunlight may enter the room (meters)

schedule.title: Day and night
schedule.description: Choose Fixed time, Dawn, Sunrise, Sunset, or Dusk for each boundary. Clock fields are used only for Fixed time. Solar times follow your Home Assistant location and time zone. Dawn and dusk use civil twilight. Night privacy overrides light and temperature, but manual pauses and travel limits still apply.

limits.title: Travel limits
limits.description: The window-open range replaces the normal range. Missing or unavailable window sensors also use the window-open range. These settings apply to this controller’s lift or tilt percentage.

comfort.title: Light and temperature (optional)
comfort.description: Skip sensors you do not use. Low light favors the daytime position. In direct sun, warmer outside than the thermostat target favors shading; cooler outside favors opening. Choose both temperature sources or neither. Temperatures are converted to Home Assistant’s units.

data.dark_lux: Room is dark at or below (lux)
data.bright_lux: Room is bright again at or above (lux)
data.temperature_deadband: Temperature difference before reacting (your HA temperature units)

manual.title: Manual control and resume
manual.description: Manual moves pause normal automation. Resume on house vacancy, room vacancy, or morning reset. Optional Forced close entity ON holds closed without a timeout, even with Automatic control OFF. Window-open limits ALWAYS remain in effect during forced close. Turn the source OFF to return to normal behavior.

data.home_entity: Anyone-home binary sensor (on means someone is home)
data.empty_hours: Resume after room is empty for (hours)
data.window_overrides_manual: Enforce window-open limits during a manual pause

group.title: Group blinds together
group.description: Members keep their individual sun tracking, sensor choices, direction, and limits. Group moves pause every member. Group resume enables automatic control for every member.

settings.title: Ready to use
settings.description: Save now or customize a section. Ordinary automatic control starts OFF. A configured Forced close entity that is already ON takes effect immediately, subject to window-open limits.

copy.title: Copy an existing setup
copy.description: Copy the latest saved settings from an existing blind or shade. The new controller will be independent and automatic control will start off.

copy_target.title: Choose the new blind
copy_target.description: Choose a new name and hardware cover. The room occupancy sensor is prefilled from the original; keep it, replace it, or clear it. All other settings are copied, including window direction, height, inversion, and window contact. Review those for the new window before enabling automatic control. A copied forced-close source also applies to the new controller, even while Automatic control is off.

error.use_original_cover: Choose the original hardware cover. Use a Better Cover group to combine controllers.
error.invalid_limits: Minimum opening must not exceed maximum opening.
error.same_times: Daytime and nighttime must use different boundaries: different fixed times or different sun events.
error.position_required: Choose a cover that supports percentage control for the selected lift or tilt channel.
error.already_configured: This cover and control channel already have a controller.
error.invalid_light_thresholds: Bright-again lux must be greater than dark lux.
error.invalid_slats: Slat spacing must not exceed slat width.
error.temperature_pair: Choose both outside temperature and thermostat sources, or leave both empty.
error.invalid_members: Select at least one existing blind controller.
error.invalid_copy_source: That source controller no longer exists. Choose another.

abort.no_members: Add at least one blind or shade before creating a group.
abort.no_copy_source: Add a blind or shade before copying a setup.
